$comment: Reviewed, time-limited exceptions to the blocking dependency audit (ADR-0019, ADR-0022). scripts/audit-gate.mts reports two things separately: the TECHNICAL audit (fails on any high or critical finding not covered here, an expired entry, an entry over 90 days, or a stale entry) and the APPROVAL of each exception. An exception is approved only when a named human, who is not the assessor, records approval.approvedBy and approval.approvedOn and the owner is confirmed. An AI assessment is not an approval. CI runs the technical audit; a release (`npm run audit -- --release`) also fails while any exception is unapproved.
